headline: DO: call Chesley C. before 9:00 — a brand-new buyer agent walks 195 Lake View at 9:00 AM this morning while the re-offer from yesterday still sits unanswered, and a competing showing is the best card you'll hold all week. · WATCH: the bank says a payment bounced overnight, and the fleet went dark at 2:52 PM yesterday.

notes: FLEET DARK ~17 HOURS — last routine line is 2:52 PM yesterday. No nightly Deep Dive, no ISA briefing, no 3:15/6:15 Delta passes, and none of this morning's stack (triage · finance · The Daily 6:25a) has fired. Classic app-closed pattern.
Nothing BLOCKED before it went dark, but two PARTIALs stand: the Brivity deep sweep ran API-only (Chrome MCP unreachable) and the accounting bank feed is frozen a 4th day.
What the dark window cost: a new 9:00 AM showing booked on 195 Lake View at 7:20 PM last night and an NSF alert at 2:23 AM both landed with no machine eyes on them until now.

callBlock.why: 🔥 THE ONE THING, and it has a 9:00 AM clock. A NEW buyer agent — not the one negotiating — tours 195 Lake View at 9:00 this morning, the 10th showing on the house. Meanwhile the re-offer that came in at 12:16 yesterday is still waiting on your seller's answer, and you also still owe him the read on Sunday 7/19 that you promised him by text. One call: the feedback you owe, then the number, then the fact that somebody else is walking it today

5167 Lake Crest — her buyer answered 'interested: Yes' in writing and nobody has called her. The physical inspection is TOMORROW at 9:00 AM and that is the one window where this deal can die. A written backup costs nothing and quietly strengthens you on any repair ask. Second backup call on the same listing is also open

His PCB condo has its first showing in weeks — Saturday 7/25 9:30 AM, buyer agent out of the Laguna Beach side. 123 days on market with zero activity, and you were about to have a price-or-reposition conversation. Have the showing conversation first. Still no email on file, so capture it on the phone

HOT FL cash 1031 buyer, ownership verified the hard way. Asked to tour by text and again by voicemail — nothing has gone back, now day 10. A 45-day identification clock on money that MUST be spent, and you hold 11 verified-yours seller names in his target ZIP. The same call can source a listing

Seller hand-raise from yesterday: he pulled a home value on a Panama City address and told the form the estimate is TOO LOW. A seller who argues with your number is a seller who wants to talk about his number — and this is a growth day

She asked to see 198 Rena 'this weekend' and you said yes — two weekends have now passed. A call-in buyer on your OWN listing is a double-end, and there is no email on file, so the phone is the only channel

Client-referral buyer, ownership verified. Referral speed-to-lead — the draft has now sat staged in Gmail since 2:16 AM Monday and never sent. Rule 12: the phone beats a draft that keeps getting re-staged

She applied a SECOND time yesterday afternoon after the recruiting pipeline was written off as empty. A candidate who comes back on her own is the cheapest recruit you'll get, and the draft has been unsent 7 days

listings.note: NEW 7:20 PM LAST NIGHT: a showing is confirmed for TODAY 9:00 AM with a buyer agent who has never shown this house — 10th showing all-time, and it lands while the conditional re-offer from 12:16 yesterday is still unanswered. That is competing interest arriving at exactly the right hour. ⚠️ The re-offer's weak spot is unchanged: the buyers' own home is NOT under contract (it goes live Monday), so the no-firm-close risk that killed round one is still sitting there — the 48-hour break clause is what makes it workable. Seller answers first; the buyer side gets the reply second. Sunday 7/19's showing has now been re-asked FIVE times by ShowingTime with nothing back. The old counter-play draft in Gmail is a hazard — its premise is gone. Delete it

Full list, fully executed 7/21. Physical inspection CONFIRMED TOMORROW Fri 7/24 9:00 AM — that is the contingency window. ⚠️ Two open items: (1) the moved-up close date is NOT agreed — the contract still reads the original date and only the lender replied; (2) a second buyer came back 'interested: Yes' from the Monday 5:30p showing — ask for a written backup before the inspection. The cancelled Wednesday 4:30 showing may still be a phantom on the calendar. Three buyers wanted this house inside 32 hours

All seven documents signed 7:37 AM yesterday including the Exclusive Right to Sell and the Coming Soon addendum. 🔴 The list price is still UNVERIFIED and must not be quoted anywhere — three different numbers are live and the real one sits in a signed PDF no routine reads. Setting it with Dennis and Lee is the blocking item on the whole launch. Next after that: photos, copy, go-live plan

SHOWING CONFIRMED Sat 7/25 9:30 AM — the first activity on this listing in weeks after 123 days on market. Buyer agent is out of the Laguna Beach side. Last feedback 7/1 was 'not interested' and the 7/10 showing was never confirmed. PCB market 7/16: 68 sold vs 218 new listings. Call Jeff with the showing news BEFORE the price conversation, then nudge for feedback Saturday afternoon — PCB feedback on this listing has never come back unasked. Still no email on file

Live offer via a buyer agent at ARC Realty with a buyer credit and a concession. Seth's question about what the concession covers is still the open item and the corrected net sheet still has not gone out — a week now. Price already validated 'just right.' The 7/15 showing still owes a read, 8 days out

The traffic king — three showings in the window but THREE reads still outstanding. The 7/14 read came back 7/20: buyer 'really liked it,' toured in pouring rain and flagged PUDDLING in the little patio area, still deciding which part of Birmingham he wants. A live maybe. Two seller talking points: check the patio grading and downspout before the next rain showing, and a still-deciding buyer argues for holding price

The objection on record is the floor plan, not the number — 7/12: 'She LOVED the yard and lot,' interior 'too compartmentalized.' Pivot the photos and copy to the lot and outdoor living. Hot inbound buyer Kimberly W. is still waiting on a showing time. 66 DOM. Client draft staged in Gmail since 7/20 and unsent

Close date 7/29 — after that there is not one dated closing on the books. Backup-interest showing Sunday 7/19, still no feedback four days on. ⚠️ FHA appraisal ordered is UNVERIFIED at day 15 — ask, don't chase. ShowingTime also still shows this ACTIVE while the deal is Clear to Close; worth eyeballing the MLS status

Closing Monday 7/27, title has acknowledged disbursement. Institutional/Lennar seller (team-align only, no seller email). Two brokerage checklist items still required: final settlement statement + proof of payment

Signed and funded 7/21. Terminal. The damp-carpet scare from the buyer's agent closed itself in 81 minutes — the sellers had already Bissell'd a couple of spots, no leak, no claim. Post-close sequence armed: Day-1 review-ask call, Day-30 check-in, Day-90 referral. One open courtesy item: the other office still owes the sellers the deed for utilities

Folder sync found a Bessemer file showing PENDING with you as listing agent, and the folder has ZERO messages. A 90-day address search and 120 days of Bessemer mail found nothing, so seller, price and close date are all UNVERIFIED and no milestone was fired. Recorded at Under Contract only so a stale email can't later fire a bogus one. Worth 60 seconds to confirm this is real

Your own SPG address, listed 7/14. Still awaiting a go-live signal, but it drew inbound demand overnight on 7/22: a buyer registered saying he'd like to learn more about the house. Buyer-side interest on a pre-launch listing is worth working now, and the reveal carousel publishes today

money.note: 🔴 A payment bounced overnight — the bank sent a not-enough-funds alert at 2:23 AM on the personal side for a transaction dated yesterday. This is the fourth straight week the same pattern has shown up, and the two systems that would have caught it early are both still dark: the accounting bank feed is frozen a 4th day, and the two SIM changes on your 2FA line from 7/21 are still unconfirmed as yours. 90 seconds in the bank app with your own eyes is today's whole ask.
